mapper.select: SELECT id, user_key, state_session_id, state_key, state_kind, state_type, state_json, state_version, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_agent_state WHERE user_key = #{userKey} AND state_session_id = #{stateSessionId} AND state_key = #{stateKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manga_agent_state ( user_key, state_session_id, state_key, state_kind, state_type, state_json, state_version, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{userKey}, #{stateSessionId}, #{stateKey}, #{stateKind}, #{stateType}, #{stateJson}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state_kind = VALUES(state_kind), state_type = VALUES(state_type), state_json = VALUES(state_json), state_version = state_version + 1, updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)

INSERT INTO manga_agent_state ( user_key, state_session_id, state_key, state_kind, state_type, state_json, state_version, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{userKey}, #{stateSessionId}, #{stateKey}, #{stateKind}, #{stateType}, #{stateJson}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT state_session_id FROM manga_agent_state WHERE user_key = #{userKey} ORDER BY state_session_id ASC
